scope_zh: 重做10组站台屋面，增加8座屋顶设备房、屋顶光伏、立柱穿屋面的开孔和泛水、40组站台设施、469块分段隔音屏，以及5座轨旁设备建筑，其中3座带百叶通风塔。

sources.title: JR East: Solar Power System on the Tokaido Line Platform at Tokyo Station
sources.verified_fact: Tracks 9/10: roofing-integrated light-transmitting PV, approximately 3846 m2. Tracks 22/23: approximately 433 m2 rooftop PV installed in March 1993.
sources.model_use: Distinct continuous blue module grid on 9/10; a separate local roof-mounted array on 22/23. The latter's modelled panel surface is recorded in the build report. Array location, exact module count and the 9/10 covered area are interpreted within the existing model footprint.

accuracy_zh: 这是基于照片的解释性模型，不是测绘复原，也不代表东京站2026年所有改建的现状。
各顶棚的坡度、高度、屋脊分段、拼接位置和设备房尺寸为照片推定；材质细部采用程序化几何。
屋顶设备房和通风建筑的具体位置、层数、门窗、冷凝机组及百叶数量为估算。
5座轨旁建筑为既有模型底座范围内的铁路设备建筑补全；不是周边高层建筑群的完整复原。
隔音屏的型式参考铁路常用构造，按既有高架外缘放置；分段高度、透明窗段和间距没有现场测量依据。
站台售货亭、饮料机、长椅、应急按钮的位置经过避让楼梯、立柱和既有家具的检查，属于合理布置，并非真实商铺点位记录。
保留原模型站台长度和轨道标高；9/10太阳能屋顶不强行扩大到官方公布的总面积。
non_destructive_edit: The ten replaced roof objects are retained in V10_Replaced_roofs_hidden. Existing columns, beams, rails, trains, station architecture and underground levels are preserved. Geometry fingerprints verify that no original mesh or object transform was changed.
new_assets: All V10 additions are procedural Blender geometry. No third-party models, photographs or texture assets were added. Original scene asset and font licences continue to apply.
